$comment: The pipeline demo spans two source trees on purpose: web/src/pipeline.ts mounts the
real Fire TV overlay client on the same page as the real dashboard, because the point
of that demo is that they are one system. Every other file in web/ stays inside its own
tree, which is what D029's two-tsconfig split enforces.
rootDir is the repository root because this one file legitimately reaches across.
It is the only config that does, and adding to it is the signal that a new file has
$excludeNote: MUST be empty. An extending config inherits `exclude` from the config it extends, and
the base excludes src/pipeline.ts precisely because the base cannot contain it — so this
file silently inherited an exclusion of the very files it exists to typecheck. That is
how `cycle(id, wait)` survived a passing typecheck: no pipeline file was in the program
